# Slack Findings Report

Use only when the user asks for a structured report. Omit sections that are outside scope. Do not paste raw workspace snapshots or unrelated private content.

## Scope

- **Workspace:** [workspace]
- **Requested task:** [task]
- **Coverage:** [channels/DMs/query/date range/result limit]
- **Observed at:** [timestamp and timezone]
- **Read-state impact:** [none observed / conversations opened / unknown]
- **Stopping condition:** [explicit end / N results reviewed / requested limit / access boundary]

## Executive summary

- [Finding supported by reviewed Slack content]
- [Decision, risk, or action item]
- [Important limitation or unresolved question]

## Findings

| Finding | Conversation | Sender / timestamp | Thread context | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [concise finding] | [#channel or DM] | [display name, Slack-rendered time] | [checked / N/A / not reviewed] | [short excerpt or permalink] |

Use short excerpts. Redact personal or unrelated information. If a finding is a summary rather than a quote, label it as a summary.

## Decisions and action items

| Type | Item | Owner | Due date | Source | Confidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [decision/action/question] | [text] | [explicit owner or “unassigned”] | [explicit date or “not stated”] | [conversation + timestamp/permalink] | [direct / inferred] |

Do not invent owners, deadlines, or decisions. Keep proposals separate from accepted decisions.
